snippets.snippet_text: "Added 9 new countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, China, Egypt, India, Japan, South Korea, and Thailand are now supported. These are Payoneer-based countries where Etsy processes fees in USD."

intake_notes: Third-party fee calculator (craftybase.com) changelog entry confirming expansion of Etsy Payoneer-based country support in March 2026. Specific, dated, and factual.
Although source is a third-party calculator rather than Etsy directly, changelog entries at this level of specificity typically reflect Etsy's own policy updates.
